messages:
Maya R: Quick preflight — planning to enable Horizon-13B-v3 in the catalog during changewindow. Proposed fallback order: horizon-13b-v2 -> horizon-7b-quant -> redwood-bert-small. No initial pin for canary; rollback criteria: +5% error rate OR median latency > 1.2s sustained for 10m. @Jorge L can you ack infra capacity?
Jorge L: checking GPU pool now. We can reserve 2 nodes for the window and sustain ~4k rps. I’ll set autoscale thresholds. OK to proceed.
Maya R: Thinking 10% traffic canary for 1h soak, then ramp if healthy.
Samir K: +1. Add a quality gate: top-5 eval exact-match drop > 3% triggers rollback.
Elaine H: ops runbook updated — if rollback happens, deploy-bot will pin previous default and cut canary traffic. I’ll be on standby.
deploy-bot: scheduled catalog enable 'Horizon-13B-v3' at 2026-03-22T21:00:00Z. Canary: 10% -> 100% over 6h.
Maya R: Added a PR to ensure fallback order enforcement and safe reorder: https://github.com/redwood-inference/catalog/pull/529 — please review.
Jorge L: noted. I’ll watch node eviction and KV cache warmup metrics.
Samir K: also suggest adding a temporary pin TTL (30m) so we can quick-revert without a full deploy.
Maya R: agree. deploy-bot, please support pin_ttl=1800s for manual rollback.
deploy-bot: ack — will apply pin_ttl=1800s when rollback command invoked.
OpsRunner: heads-up — EU synthetic tests run at 22:00 UTC and may overlap; recommend delaying EU tests by 2h to avoid noise.
Maya R: prefer earlier deploy to avoid late-night work. @Elaine H can you coordinate QA schedule?
Elaine H: will ask QA to push EU synth tests +2h.
Samir K: post-deploy checks: latency P50/P95, error_count, eval top-5 accuracy, and cost-per-1k-tokens. Any trigger -> rollback.
Maya R: if clean at +2h, ramp to 50% then to 100% over the next 4h.
Jorge L: capacity alerts set. Autoscaler will add 2 nodes at 80% GPU util.
Maya R: final voice check: Maya yes, Jorge yes, Samir yes, Elaine yes. Rolling in ~40m.
Elaine H: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: executing enable now... logs: `started canary route creation`
deploy-bot: canary live at 10% traffic. monitor: https://telemetry.redwood.internal/canary/7101234567
Samir K: initial latency looks fine — P95 ~ 850ms.
Maya R: watching eval diffs closely.
Samir K: quality gate passed at 30m. no regression on top-5.
Maya R: ramping to 50% now.
deploy-bot: traffic ramp to 50% complete.
OpsRunner: seeing increased cache misses for horizon-13b-v3; expect temporary cost bump during warmup.
Maya R: acceptable for canary. continue monitoring.
deploy-bot: at 3h mark, full rollout initiated per schedule.
Jorge L: eviction spike at ~3.2h but autoscaler responded; node add completed.
Elaine H: all checks green from ops and QA. closing loop.
Maya R: thank you team — I’ll draft release notes.
Maya R: release-note draft: 'Horizon-13B-v3 enabled in catalog. Fallback ordering set to horizon-13b-v2 -> horizon-7b-quant -> redwood-bert-small. Temporary pin TTL=30m available for rollback. Rollback criteria and cost implications documented.'
Samir K: add note about KV cache warmup cost for first 24h.
Maya R: added. Thread closed unless regressions show up.
